findings.title: After the Phase-1 ceiling P-112 refuses every new attempt, reruns included
findings.evidence: phase1_ngc_launch_cx2v004.py L518: next_attempt calls remaining_wall(phase_ceiling_utc, now_utc), and decision_for (L2937-2944) passes cfg.phase1_ceiling_utc. fresh_launch_plan L2684 and the commit check L2720 also call remaining_wall(phase1_ceiling). All three refuse once now >= 2026-11-06T05:59Z. The design is deliberate (docstring L513-514: 'Phase 1 only limits Phase-1 admissions'). V006: A249 item 1 (L4279-4281) 'a reporting and freeze boundary only. No stop happens there'; A248 (L4262) 'It keeps running for Phase 2'; A245 item 5 (L4198) 'The schedule ceiling ... is the only stop'; A223 G25 (L3340-3341) makes every later attempt of a call P-112's, so no other lawful rerun path exists. Effect (helper probes): a model failure after Nov 6 cannot get its solo confirmation rerun and so can never be counted (the asymmetry A249 item 2 forbids); CAP and INFRA reruns are refused the same way. Honest timeline: S9 Phase-1 NGC launches about Oct 30 to Nov 2 (A247); serial first-attempt wall 610,324 s, so many ends and reruns fall after Nov 6.
findings.timing: Bites only after 2026-11-06T05:59Z. No effect on verdict night or on Phase-1 reruns before Nov 6. A fix is needed before Nov 6.
findings.fix: Remove the Phase-1 remaining_wall checks at L518, L2684 and L2720, leaving the Phase-2 wall as the only stop. Keep the Phase-1 cutoff only in phase_disposition and terminal_set. Invert the two builder tests (test_integrated_draft006 L332; test_launch_commit_integrated003 L122-124). Root rules whether first admissions are allowed after Nov 6.
findings.contingency: This becomes a NOTE only if root names a different Phase-2 rerun owner, which would supersede A223 G25.
